items.headline: O: compute strategy targets controllable capacity & cost
items.summary: O published guidance on how its full-stack compute strategy aims to improve control over capacity, performance, and cost while business usage grows across consumer and enterprise.

items.headline: O: SEC Form D—exempt offering by O Startup Fund II
items.summary: SEC Form D for a securities exempt offering filed by O Startup Fund II, L.P. (accepted/effective on 2026-08-26). This may support ongoing investment activity but discloses limited deal terms publicly.

items.headline: G: Series A closes—$3.5B valuation
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A valuing it at $3.5B, taking recent funding to $1B total and funding expansion of its AI inference footprint.
